lines.text: Jotham became king at twenty-five, reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did right like his father Uzziah, yet the people behaved corruptly.
Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD and worked extensively on the wall at Ophel.
He built cities in the hill country of Judah and fortresses and towers in the forests.
Jotham fought the king of the Moabites and defeated them, and that year they gave him a hundred talents of silver.
Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of Salt, and his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
